subject: Eval access window & packaging options
messages:
From: Jamie Lee <jamie@orchidlabs.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 16:22:00 -0500
Subject: Eval access window — short extension needed

Hey Karthik,

Quick one — our small proof-of-concept has hit a burst over the past 36 hours. The team is ready to continue validation but we're blocked by quota/timeout limits in the hosted sandbox.

Can Redwood push a short access window (3 weeks) so we can finish the final integration tests? We're open to either:
- a 3-week access window at the current rate, or
- a 2-week extension + small usage credit bucket for overrun.

We don't want to renegotiate the whole price, just a short runway so the pilot can complete. If you need usage numbers I can attach a snapshot.

Thanks —
Jamie
Jamie Lee
VP Product, Orchid Labs
jamie@orchidlabs.com
(415) 555-0192
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthishk@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lee <jamie@orchidlabs.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 17:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Eval access window — short extension needed

Jamie — thanks for the note and for flagging the burst. Sorry to hear you're blocked. Two quick clarifying Qs before I propose a concrete path:

1) Can you confirm the expected peak tokens/day for the next 3 weeks (ballpark is fine)?
2) Are you using any private models or integrations that would require a dedicated instance?

I'm looping Laura (solutions lead) to validate whether we can extend the sandbox provisioning vs. issuing a credit bucket. High-level options I can put on paper:

A) Timebox access window: extend the current eval environment for 21 days. No price change; we add an engineering throttle/guardrail to avoid runaway costs.
B) Credit top-up: give a small usage credit (X token-equivalent) + 7 day extension if you hit a hard cap.
C) Hybrid: 14 day extension + modest credit buffer and a one-time operational uplift (one-time credit or discounted overage).

If you can send the usage snapshot I can fast-track approval.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthishk@redwood.com
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthishk@redwood.com>, Jamie Lee <jamie@orchidlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:34:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Eval access window — short extension needed

Adding a quick technical read:

Jamie — if you're on the hosted eval we can extend the access window without moving you to Dedicated. Implications:
- We will provision an additional ephemeral capacity slice that will be throttled at 1.5x your current sustained throughput to protect the cluster.
- We'll enable prefix/KV caching for the test runs you described to reduce token cost for repeated prompts.
- Engineering asks a usage snapshot so we can size the buffer correctly (attached).

Suggested recommendation from a delivery standpoint: option C (14 day extension + 15% usage credit buffer). That gives you time to complete integration tests and gives us a conservative buffer so we don't end up in an emergency surge.

Attachment: [attachment: POC_Usage_Snapshot.csv (CSV)]

Laura Bennett
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: marcus.lin@redwood.com <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthishk@redwood.com, Jamie Lee <jamie@orchidlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 11:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Eval access window — short extension needed

Thanks team — quick commercial decision: I'm comfortable approving a short runway with mixed terms to preserve momentum. Approval summary:

- Provide a 14-day access window (option C) starting on 2027-03-04.
- Apply a 15% usage credit buffer (non-refundable) that can be applied to any overage during the 14 days.
- If Orchid still needs runway after the 14 days, we will automatically provide a 7-day emergency access but overages during that emergency window will be billed at a 20% discount on list overage rates (manager concession).

Please treat the 15% credit as a one-time concession tied to this PoC window. Karthik — you can confirm and send the DocuSign addendum; Laura, engineering should stand by for the window on 2027-03-04.

Marcus Lin
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthishk@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lee <jamie@orchidlabs.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Eval access window — short extension needed

Jamie — good news, we're able to put the plan in place. Terms below (final):

1) 14-day access window beginning 2027-03-04 (hosted eval environment extended).
2) 15% usage credit buffer applied to overages during the 14 days (one-time, non-refundable).
3) If Orchid requests more runway after the 14 days, Redwood will trigger a 7-day emergency extension; any overage during the emergency period will be billed at a 20% discount on our standard overage rate.

Action items:
- Jamie: confirm acceptance of the terms by reply and sign the attached addendum (DocuSign link). Attachment: [orchid-access-docusign-link.txt] (DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/link/EX-12345-orchid)
- Laura: standby to provision the ephemeral slice and activate prefix/KV caching early morning 2027-03-04.

Jamie — happy to jump on a 15-minute call if you want to walk the terms. Appreciate the quick coordination — let's get the pilot over the finish line.

—Karthik
